title: VERIFY T-468: only an issued judge's signed verdict disposes a suit
acceptance_criteria: Replay the happy path in a throwaway root. In throwaway copies: drop the colegiado check; accept a verdict act signed by the claimant; allow a second disposal. Each mutant must fail at least one test.
Confirm the judge warrant draft is unsigned, the live roster is unchanged, and an ordinary case record is unchanged. Full suite, then verdict.

notes.note:
VERIFIED (replayed independently, not trusting the producer's report):

1) Diff scope: `git diff --stat HEAD -- .harness/bin/precedent.py` shows only precedent.py
   changed (+286/-2); .harness/tests/test_precedent_t468_suits.py, .harness/judge-seat-draft-T468.md,
   .harness/warrants/W-003.json are new/untracked. attest.py and CLAUDE.md untouched, confirmed by
   reading the diff directly, not by trusting the note.

2) `python3 -m pytest .harness/tests/test_precedent_t468_suits.py -v` -> 15 passed (TheSuitFields x4,
   TheVerdict x7, TheNoticeVerb x3), matching the note's count.

3) Full suite replay: `python3 -m pytest .harness/tests -q` -> "1169 passed, 4 skipped in 128.49s",
   exit 0. Matches producer's claimed count exactly on this direct run (no flake observed).

4) Mutant testing (cognitive diversity, 3 throwaway copies under <tmp>, never the live tree):
   - M1 drop colegiado check (`colegiado_err = None` instead of calling _judge_issue_check) ->
     test_refuses_a_judge_name_not_issued_in_the_judge_colegiado FAILS (0 != 1). Caught.
   - M2 bypass signature verification (`verified, verify_why = True, None` instead of calling
     attest._verify_sig) -- stands in for "accept a verdict act signed by [a key other than the
     judge's]" -> test_refuses_an_act_that_does_not_verify_under_the_judges_key FAILS (0 != 1). Caught.
   - M3 drop the already-disposed check (`case_err = None` instead of calling
     validate_case_for_disposal before dispose) -> allows a second disposal ->
     test_refuses_a_case_already_disposed FAILS (0 != 1). Caught.
   All three mutants each fail exactly one targeted test and no others pass-through silently.

5) Judge warrant draft: `.harness/warrants/W-003.json` has no `.sig` file (`ls .harness/warrants/`
   shows W-001.json, W-002.json, W-002.json.sig, W-003.json -- no W-003.json.sig).
   `python3 .harness/bin/warrant.py reconcile` -> clean:true, W-003 listed in warrants_unsigned
   alongside W-001 (the documented normal state).

6) Live roster unchanged: `git diff --stat HEAD -- .harness/roster.json` and
   `git status --porcelain .harness/roster.json` both empty.

7) Ordinary case record unchanged (different method than producer's source-scan/unit-test claim):
   ran `precedent.py case open` directly against a fresh throwaway root with no --root in the
   pytest harness -- a plain CLI invocation, not the test suite -- for a case with no suit flags:
   resulting JSON keys were exactly {id, question, task, opened_by, ts, status, disposal}, no "suit"
   key, matching the pre-T-468 schema byte-for-byte. A second invocation with --claimant/--respondent/
   --contract/--damages-claimed produced the same five keys plus one "suit" dict with the four fields,
   confirming the schema claim independently of the bundled unit test.

8) judge-seat-draft-T468.md read directly: matches W-003.json's draft command, the recusal
   checklist is explicitly advisory (PR-017, not a gate), and states nothing has been signed.

All acceptance criteria of T-468 and both criteria of T-469 are satisfied by direct replay.
